izzyondroid:com.onefishtwo.bbqtimer.description:
Combined interval timer/stopwatch = periodic alarms + elapsed time. Reminds you periodically to turn the food and tracks the total cooking time.
 Quick access via lock screen notification , pull-down notification , and home screen widget .
 Editable menu of interval times . Quickly access your favorite timers with notes.
 Changeable alarms while it’s running.
 No ads.
 Type in the interval time: minutes , minutes:seconds , or hours:minutes:seconds .
 Example intervals 
 10 = 10 minutes
 7:30 = 7 minutes, 30 seconds
 3:15:00 = 3 hours, 15 minutes
 Short forms 
 12:00 = 12:0 = 12: = 12 = 12 minutes
 0:09 = :9 = 9 seconds
 2:00:00 = 2:0:0 = 2:: = 120 = 2 hours
 Tips 
 Tap the checkbox to turn the periodic reminder alarms on/off.
 Tap the time display to cycle between stopped → running → paused → stopped .
 Add the BBQ Timer widget to the home screen. Tap the widget’s elapsed time to start/pause/stop.
 Tap the widget’s background or its countdown time to open the app.
 Resize the widget (long-press it then drag its resize handles) to see more or less info.
 To remove the widget, long-press and drag it to “× Remove”.
 While BBQ Timer is running or paused , it appears on the lock screen and in the pull-down notification so you can see and control it in those places. To put it on the lock screen, put it in Pause or Play mode by tapping buttons in the app or the home screen widget.
 Long-press the app’s home screen icon, then tap the “Pause at 00:00” shortcut (on Android 7.1+) to make it Paused and ready on the lock screen.
 Tap ▲ in the alarm interval text field for the menu of interval times. Tap “Edit these intervals…” in the menu to customize the menu.
 Long-press ▲ to customize the menu.
 The app, home screen widget, and pull-down notification show the countdown interval time as well as the total elapsed time (requires Android 7+).
 In the app, the phone’s volume keys adjust the Alarm volume.
 You can change BBQ Timer’s “Alarm” sound in Settings / Notifications. Don’t pick “None” if you want to hear the interval alarms. To restore the app’s cowbell sound, uninstall and reinstall the app.
 Note: These System Settings are required to hear and see BBQ Timer alarms: 
 Audible “Alarm volume” level.
 Lock screen / Show all or non-private notifications.
 Apps / BBQ Timer “Show notifications”, not Silent. (Optionally override “Do Not Disturb”.)
 Apps / BBQ Timer “Alarm” notification category / “Show notifications”, not “Silent”, “Make sound and pop on screen”, sound choice not “None”, Importance “High” or higher to hear and see on the lock screen and in the notification area.
 Apps / Special app access / Alarms & reminders / Allowed.
 Notifications / App settings / BBQ Timer / On.

fdroid:com.devwithzachary.completelinuxi.description:
Run genuine, full-featured Linux distributions natively on your Android phone or tablet: 100% rootless!
Complete Linux Installer (Linux on Android) brings a multi-distribution Linux ecosystem, concurrent multi-tab terminal, graphical XFCE desktop, and 1-click developer stacks to your device without root access, unlocked bootloaders, or custom ROMs.
Powered by a native PRoot user-space virtualization engine and POSIX PTY terminal bridge, Complete Linux Installer transforms your device into a portable Linux workstation, server host, desktop computer, or learning environment.
🔒 100% ROOTLESS & COMPLETELY SAFE

• Zero root access, unlocked bootloaders, or system partition modifications required.
• Completely sandboxed: cannot brick your device and never touches Android system partitions or personal files.

🐧 MULTI-DISTRIBUTION LINUX CATALOG

• Ubuntu 26.04 LTS: Official long-term support base for general computing and development.

• Alpine Linux 3.21: Minimalist musl/busybox environment (~10MB rootfs) with instant boot times and tiny memory footprint.
• Arch Linux ARM: Bleeding-edge rolling release with the pacman package manager.

📑 CONCURRENT MULTI-TAB TERMINAL
• Run and manage multiple interactive terminal sessions simultaneously.
• Dynamic tab strip with live status indicators, session highlights, and custom tab renaming.
• Independent PTY subprocesses maintain full interactive state in the background.
• Pinned extra-keys toolbar with Ctrl, Alt, Esc, Tab, Paste, and directional arrows.

🖥️ FULL GRAPHICAL DESKTOP (XFCE4 & VNC)

• Built-in TigerVNC server with 1-touch launch guidance.
• Connect via any Android VNC viewer app or external monitor for a windowed desktop PC experience on mobile.
🎛️ MULTI-CONTAINER DASHBOARD & SYSTEM MONITOR

🛠️ 1-CLICK SOFTWARE & DEVELOPER STACKS

fdroid:com.elektropepi.bootboi.name: BootBoi
fdroid:com.elektropepi.bootboi.summary: Turn on/off your remote machine without leaving your couch!
fdroid:com.elektropepi.bootboi.description:
Ever wanted to turn on your remote machine (laptop, Raspberry, NAS), but didn't want to leave the couch? Well I for sure
understand this problem to the heart. But fear no more, as BootBoi is here to save you from the gruesome task of standing up
and pushing a button.
BootBoi features remote power on / power off / reboot for as many remote machines as you can imagine with the
combined power of SSH and Wake On Lan.
Preparing your Remote Machine
* Before you can use BootBoi with your remote machines, you have to prepare them for **remote** rebooting and powering them on/off.
Power On
* To power a remote device on, BootBoi uses Wake On Lan .
* This needs to be enabled in the BIOS of the machine you want to power on, read more here .
Power Off / Reboot
* BootBoi uses SSH to execute whoami, poweroff and reboot on the remote machine.
* So make sure that
 * Those binaries are available and in $PATH
 * The SSH user has sudo access to whoami, poweroff and reboot
 * Either by allowing the user sudo access only to those binaries via the sudoers file (recommended)
 * E.g. `echo "my_ssh_user ALL=(ALL) /sbin/reboot,/sbin/poweroff,/usr/bin/whoami" >> /etc/local/sudoers`
 * Or by using root as SSH user in BootBoi

fdroid:com.jjrapps.constanza.name: Constanza - Good habits
fdroid:com.jjrapps.constanza.summary: Habit reminders you answer without opening the app. No cloud, no ads.
fdroid:com.jjrapps.constanza.description:
Constanza is a habit-tracking app that opens and works in seconds. No account, nothing synced to any cloud, no ads and no analytics: it does not even declare the internet permission, so it could not connect even if it wanted to.
Each habit gets its own colour -from a palette of 21, or a custom one from its own hue/saturation/brightness picker- and its own schedule: every day, several times a day, a number of times a week, specific days of the week, a day of the month, or every N days. Any schedule can carry one or several reminder times.
The Today screen groups what is due now, what is due later, and what you have already answered, and you can step back to any past day to see what happened. Answering is one tap: Yes or No, no dialog to open. And when a reminder arrives, you can answer it right from the notification -Yes, No or Snooze- without even unlocking the phone.
A day you do not answer does not disappear: at midnight, any slot left unanswered becomes "Missed". Constanza does not hide what you let slip to make you feel better about it; it records it, and that record is what the streak and the compliance number are built from. Progress shows the current streak, the best streak, and the last-30-days compliance percentage for each habit.
Reminders survive a phone reboot and a time or timezone change: you do not need to reopen the app to keep them firing. If your phone does not grant the exact-alarm permission by default, Constanza tells you without blocking anything and takes you to the setting; if you would rather not grant it, reminders still arrive, just with a few minutes of slack.
At 23:30 by default, if something is still unanswered, a review notification reminds you before the day closes; and at 7:00, another one tells you how yesterday went and opens its list. And in Settings you can change how long a snooze lasts, pick the language (following the system, English or Spanish), and export or import all your data as a file, through the system's own file picker: it is your copy, not ours.
The interface is dark, always, with no light mode. That is not an oversight: the background is deliberately neutral so the only colour on screen is the one you gave each habit.
What you get:
• Habits with six schedule types and one or more reminder times.
• 21 colours plus a custom hue/saturation/brightness picker.
• Reminders answered Yes/No/Snooze right from the notification.
• An unanswered day is recorded as "Missed" at midnight, never hidden.
• Current streak, best streak, and last-30-days compliance per habit.
• A nightly review notification, configurable, or only when something is pending.
• Data export and import to a file, through the system picker.
• Reminders that survive reboots and time changes.
• English and Spanish.
• No accounts, no cloud, no ads, no tracking, no internet permission.

OctoLab is a free and open-source, unofficial GitLab client for Android. It works with gitlab.com and self-hosted GitLab instances (Community or Enterprise Edition).
FEATURES
Accounts

* Multi-account: self-hosted and gitlab.com side by side
Role-aware
* Shows only what your GitLab role allows (Guest, Reporter, Developer, Maintainer, Owner)
* Actions your role doesn't allow are hidden or explained
Issues and merge requests
* Browse, create, edit and comment on issues
* Filter by label, assignee or milestone
* View merge requests, comment and review diffs
* Subscribe to or unsubscribe from issues and merge requests
* Epics (GitLab Premium and Ultimate): a group's epics with their child items, comments and reactions
To-dos and notifications
* To-dos | Participating: your to-dos, and new comments on issues and merge requests you take part in
* Group by project, filter, mark as done or read
* Notifications for new to-dos and comments, with counts per account
Activity
* Your activity, your projects' and starred projects' activity
Projects
* Browse files, README, branches, tags, commits and releases
* Search a project's code
* Projects and groups by your role or visibility, with search
* Images, videos and files open in the app
Also
* Bookmarks for projects, groups, issues, merge requests, commits and snippets
* Snippets, groups, Explore and search
* Dark and light theme
* Markdown rendering: GFM tables, task lists, code blocks, images
No tracking, no analytics, no proprietary services.
OctoLab requests the "install packages" permission solely to let you install release APKs you choose to download from a project's Releases page within the app — it is never used automatically or in the background.
OctoLab began as a GitLab-focused fork of OctoDroid (gh4a), an open-source GitHub client, and is maintained by SecNinjaz. OctoLab is not affiliated with or endorsed by GitLab Inc. GitLab is a trademark of GitLab Inc.

Object of the Game 
Be the first player to fill a row, column, or diagonal with 4 stones.
 Setting Up the Game 
First select the options on the right-hand side of the screen. Below
is an explanation of the controls:
 Type 
Select the type of player. A player can be a human or a computer. You
can play against a friend or the computer. You can even watch the
computer play itself!
 Skill 
If this player's type is "Computer," this option sets the skill level
of the computer's Artificial Intelligence. (Don't be disappointed if
you cannot beat the computer at the hardest setting—it's impossible!)
 How to Play 
Black is the first player to take a turn.
The very first turn consists of only one move. Player 1 (black) gets
to place a stone anywhere on the board.
For the next turn, Player 2 (white) gets to place 2 stones on the
board. If Player 2 completes a pair of symbols, he/she can remove
Player 1's stone from the board.
All subsequent turns are like Player 2's first turn and follow this
pattern:
The current player places a stone on the board.
If the symbol on the board position just played matches a symbol
under any of the current player's other stones, he/she must
immediately remove a stone from the other player.
The current player places a second stone on the board.
If the current player completes a second pair of symbols, he/she
removes another stone from the other player.
The game ends when either:
A player completes an entire row, column, or diagonal with 4 stones.
It is impossible for the current player to move (a tie).

 A note to everyone who was supporting SuperFreezZ over the years:
 SuperFreezZ was my first "real" programming project, and I was incredibly happy about strangers donating to me and translating the app into languages I never heard of, and all the positive feedback I received. My start into the world of free and open source software couldn't have been better.
 It is hard to imagine now that back in 2018, when I made my first commit, I barely knew how to program at all. I didn't know where to start, so I just forked an app called "APK Extractor", and started finding out. I learned how to organize a (small) codebase, how to interact with a small-but-supportive community, and how to stay focused when there are lots of nice features that could be implemented.
 But the time has come to slowly wind down SuperFreezZ. These days, Android devices make it harder and harder for an app like SuperFreezZ to work properly. Also, Android devices are anyways restricting the amount of time an app is allowed to run in the background, making an app like SuperFreezZ less essential (without giving the user control over it, though). Myself, I am mostly busy working on other projects these days (mainly "Delta Chat" and "Chatmail").
 It's not over yet, though! If you have an old and slow phone, or if you like that SuperFreezZ gives you control over which app runs and which does not, then enjoy. And who knows, maybe one day, I will revisit this first project of mine, adding more of the features that were asked for over the years, or maybe someone will fork it.
 If SuperFreezZ does not work for you, here are a few alternatives I found on F-Droid (though I can't personally vouch for them):
 "Force Stop Helper": Similar to SuperFreezZ, with less features but still maintained, and you need to press "Force Stop" by yourself
 "Drowser": Uses Root to prevent apps from running in the background
 "Shelter": Allows you to isolate apps (and optionally to keep them from running in the background), but requires some extra storage to work
 Thanks again for being part of this!
 If you want to try out SuperFreezZ, here you go:
 SuperFreezZ
 Get back control over what runs on your phone
 Enhance battery life and reduce mobile data usage by freezing rarely used apps
 Especially useful while you are on a tour, where you need only some apps but a long battery life
 Greenify can also do this, but it is not Open Source.
 SuperFreezZ is not yet another task manager promising to delete 10 GB of data per month or making your device 2x as fast. This is impossible.
 Instead, SuperFreezZ is honest about its disadvantages: Freezing daily used apps probably drains your battery a little faster. Also, these apps will take longer to start when you use them the next time: SuperFreezZ will super freeze your apps, it takes about 1-3 seconds to un-freeze them. Greenify has the same disadvantages, except that the author of Greenify does not warn you about it. So: Just do not overdo it, and SuperFreezZ will be super useful.

 Untrusted apps (that you do not want to run in the background)
 Apps you rarely use
 Annoying apps
 Features

Gett -The Black Taxi App
Ride iconic black cabs across London with Gett - your go-to rideshare app for quick family trips, airport transfers, and everyday journeys. Available on demand or reserved in advance, with an average wait time of under 4 minutes in central London.
Download Gett now and book black cabs that come to you.
Book an Iconic Black Cab
Experience London's most comfortable and convenient ride in a spacious 5 or 6-seater black cab. Enjoy fast, door-to-door rides in premium vehicles, with a separate driver compartment for privacy and air conditioning that you control.
Reliable Airport Transfers
Book a taxi to and from all the major airports in London, including Heathrow and Gatwick. There's plenty of room for all your luggage! Fast airport rides with priority booking available.
Family-Friendly Taxis
Black cabs are perfect for families with spacious interiors, room for strollers, and kid-friendly features. Book quick, safe family rides across London with drivers you can trust.
Order for Family and Friends
Hail taxis for your loved ones with Gett Family. Book, pay, and track your taxi all in one place - from pickup to arrival. Whether you need to arrange a school drop-off, a hospital trip for an elderly relative, or simply a ride home late at night, they won’t need to download a thing.
Priority Booking & Fast Rides
Black cabs use bus lanes to beat traffic, making your journey faster than regular taxis. Need a ride urgently? Choose the Gett Priority option for even quicker pickup times.
Fully Accessible Rides
All black cabs are wheelchair accessible as a standard feature. Book accessible rides with confidence - every journey is designed to be comfortable for all passengers.
Get There Faster
Booking a black cab means getting a driver who has passed The Knowledge - the world's toughest taxi exam. Cabbies know the city better than a GPS and can beat the traffic by using bus lanes - making black cab trips the quickest way to travel by taxi.
Passenger Safety
At Gett, your safety is our priority. Vehicles and drivers are licensed by TfL, and their details are confirmed before arrival. You can track progress from order to destination. Additionally, we offer a range of safety features such as driver ratings and ride location sharing to support you on your journey.
Eco-Friendly Electric Cabs
Gett donates 1p to Trees for Cities, a registered charity (number 1032154), for every ride a customer books and completes through the app. We also offset all the CO2 emissions from those rides with certified carbon offsetting projects. You can also choose the e-black cab vehicle class to book an electric black taxi.
Pre-Book & On-Demand
Book a ride ahead of time, or hail a cab virtually with on-demand booking. Priority booking available for urgent journeys.
Price Estimates
See the estimated meter fare for your taxi trip before you book and pay cashless through the app.
Rate & Tip Your Driver
Give your cab driver a rating up to 5 stars and let other travelers know how they did. Leave drivers a tip directly in the app if you're happy with your trip!
Customer Support
Need help or have a question? You can reach our team, who are available 24/7 via the live chat function in the app.

apple-macos:6479644903.name: PoweReader: AI RSS Reader
apple-macos:6479644903.description:
PoweReader is an RSS reader for iPhone and Mac. Lots of feeds, the essentials in minutes: AI picks the articles worth reading, summarizes them and reads them to you, and translates articles in other languages. It also works with your Feedbin, Miniflux, FreshRSS, NewsBlur, Tiny Tiny RSS or Fever account.
DAILY PICKS
The main stories in your feeds, in minutes. Open Discover and AI picks a few stories from your feeds. Each comes with a summary, key developments, what sources say and the articles that covered it. You can also listen to it as a briefing.
AI SUMMARY
The key points of an article in seconds, with an optional illustration. Summaries can also be generated on your device with the offline model. You can also summarize a category, a feed or the unread list: the list summary is split by topic, and you can tap any link to open the article.
AUDIO SUMMARY
When you can't look at the screen, AI reads an article's summary aloud. Playback starts a few seconds after you tap play.
TRANSLATION
Foreign-language articles are translated paragraph by paragraph, with the translation below each original paragraph. You can also show the translation only. Choose online AI translation, Apple Translate or offline translation.
YOUR OWN AI SERVICE
With Premium, connect the AI service of your choice and use your own API key for summaries, images and translation.
RSS SERVICES AND FEEDS
Sign in with Feedbin, NewsBlur, Miniflux, FreshRSS, Tiny Tiny RSS or any Fever API server, and unread and starred articles sync both ways. Or start right away with the built-in local account, no sign-up needed: the Feed Library has 130+ feeds by topic, or paste any feed address.
ICLOUD SYNC
With Premium, feeds, read status and starred articles sync between iPhone and Mac through iCloud.
READING
Read articles offline or in dark mode, with code blocks and mathematical formulas displayed correctly.

apple-macos:6767903343.name: Zywa: Fitness & Coaching
apple-macos:6767903343.description:
Zywa is one app for two kinds of people: anyone who wants to train with a clear plan, and coaches who want to run their whole coaching business from their phone.
Z AI — START TRAINING TODAY
• No coach yet? Z AI builds your starter workout plan and daily calorie and macro targets in about two minutes, from what you've already told us.
• Ask for changes in plain English, like "swap the squats" or "make it 3 days", and your plan updates. Or edit it yourself, any time.
• An optional body check measures front and side photos on your phone and deletes them straight away.
• Z AI uses Apple Intelligence and runs entirely on your iPhone, so your chat and answers stay on your phone. Requires an iPhone or iPad that supports Apple Intelligence. Available in English for now.

• Build weekly routines or repeating cycles (2 on, 1 off, and more) with a dated calendar of what's next.
• Log every set with a Live Activity on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island — no need to unlock your phone mid-set.
• Log sets straight from your Apple Watch, with a rest timer and personal-record alerts on your wrist.
• Personal records tracked automatically: heaviest set, estimated 1RM and session volume, celebrated when you beat them. Optional RPE per set.
• Nutrition that fits how you eat: calorie and macro targets, food logging with barcode scanning, recipes, supplements and water.
• Progress you can see: streaks, charts, measurements, and a Home Screen widget.
• An exercise library with a 3D muscle explorer, plus your own custom exercises.
• Works with Apple Health: reads steps and active energy, writes your workouts.
TRAIN WITH A COACH
• Your coach's program appears in the app, session by session, with notes on every exercise.
• Check-ins go straight to your coach.
• Real chat: replies, read receipts, voice notes, photos, videos and files.
• Book sessions in your coach's available slots, in your own time zone.
FOR COACHES
• Build and assign complete programs from your phone — templates, multi-week programs, supersets, per-exercise notes. Edit a single upcoming session without touching the rest.

• Design your own check-in forms and review submissions in one inbox.
• Session booking: set your availability, clients book themselves.
• Grow with sub-coaches who see only the clients you assign them.
• The same tools on a bigger screen at coach.zywa.ae.
PRICING
Zywa is free for everyone who trains. Coach accounts are free too, for up to 10 active clients — and every coach you refer earns you 5 more.
Available in English and Arabic.
Zywa is built in Dubai. Questions or ideas: hello@zywa.ae

 Access browser tabs: 
 Extension need to know URLs of each tab so it won't unload tab with site that is in whitelist.
